# TreasuryPilot: API Specification (v1)

**Status:** Draft for gate G2 · **Style:** REST + JSON, OpenAPI 3.1 generated by FastAPI (ADR-010)
**Base URL:** `/v1` · **Auth:** session cookie (`tp_session`) + `X-CSRF-Token` on mutations (ADR-009)

## 0. Common conventions

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Tenancy | Org-scoped routes start with `/v1/orgs/{orgId}`. The user must be a member; otherwise 404 (no existence leak). |
| Permissions | Listed per endpoint by role: `OWN` Owner, `APR` Approver, `OPR` Operator, `FIN` Finance, `GRD` Guardian, `ADM` OrgAdmin, `AUD` Auditor, `ANY` any member. |
| Amounts | Decimal **strings** in base units, e.g. `"25000000"` (ADR-014). |
| Addresses | 0x-checksummed strings. |
| Idempotency | `Idempotency-Key` header **required** on POSTs marked 🔁. Repeating a call with the same key returns the original response. |
| Pagination | `?cursor=&limit=` → `{items, nextCursor}`. |
| Errors | RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`: `{type, title, status, code, detail, instance, errors?, fields?}`. `code` values are stable (see §9). |
| Concurrency | Mutable resources return `ETag`/`version`. Updates need `If-Match`, otherwise `412`. |

## 2. Treasury & chain (M02)

| Method | Endpoint | Purpose | Perm | Request → Response | Errors |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/chains` | Supported chains and assets | auth | → `{chains[{chainId, assets[]}]}` | |
| POST | `/orgs/{orgId}/treasuries` | Create a treasury | OWN, ADM | `{chainId, assetId, wallets[{role, safeAddress, label}]}` → `201 {treasury}` | 422 `NOT_A_SAFE`, `WRONG_CHAIN`, `DUPLICATE_WALLET`, `UNSUPPORTED_ASSET` |
| POST | `/orgs/{orgId}/safes/deploy-tx` | Build a Safe deployment transaction | OWN, ADM | `{chainId, owners[], threshold}` → `{chainId, transaction:{to,data,value}}`; submitted by the connected wallet | 422 `INVALID_SAFE_CONFIGURATION`; 503 `SAFE_DEPLOYMENT_UNAVAILABLE`, `RPC_UNAVAILABLE` |
| GET | `/orgs/{orgId}/treasuries` | List the organization's treasuries for the consolidated view | ANY | → `{items[{id, chainId, chainName, assetId, assetSymbol, assetDecimals, assetIsTest, status, coverage, createdAt}]}` | One row per treasury; no amount or counter aggregation across assets; `assetDecimals`/`assetIsTest` are null when the asset is missing from the startup configuration |
| GET | `/orgs/{orgId}/treasuries/{tId}` | Treasury state for the dashboard (balances, position, coverage, mandate, today's budget, queues, activity) | ANY | → `{treasury{…, coverage}, wallets[{…, balance, buffer, target}], warnings[], mandate, budgets[], staleness, position, queues, activity[], borrowProposalId?}`; see below | 404 `TREASURY_NOT_FOUND` |
| POST | `/orgs/{orgId}/treasuries/{tId}/module/deploy-tx` | Build module deployment and enablement Safe transactions | OWN | `{mandate, buffers}` → `{governanceTx, operationalGovernanceTxs[], predictedModuleAddress}` | 503 `MODULE_DEPLOYMENT_UNAVAILABLE`, `RPC_UNAVAILABLE`; 409 if setup is already open |

`GET /orgs/{orgId}/treasuries/{tId}` response (TRS-009). All amounts are integer base-unit strings (ADR-014). Decisions: `coverage` stays **inside `treasury`** (it is the same object as the coverage endpoints return; there is no top-level `coverage`), and a treasury has **no `name`**: clients show `chainName · assetSymbol` from `/chains`.

| Field | Shape | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `wallets[].balance`, `buffer`, `target` | base units; `target` is never below `buffer` (Safe T has no target of its own) | latest chain snapshot (`snapshots`, M06); left out of a wallet whose read failed |
| `mandate` | `{version, status, expiresAt}` or `null` = none set | the Active version, else the latest version that is not a Draft |
| `budgets` | `[{action: PAY\|REFILL, usedToday, dailyLimit, perRequest}]` for the current UTC day; `[]` if the module has no mandate | on-chain `usedToday` counters against the on-chain mandate limits, same block as the balances |
| `staleness` | `{blockNumber, observedAt, stale}`; `stale` when `observedAt` is older than 180 s (3 missed 60 s dashboard cycles) | the snapshot behind every chain number above |
| `position` | `{safeUsdc, aUsdc, poolLiquidity, requiredReserve{paymentReserve, floor, holds, total}, availableForSupply, supplyApyBps, lastAction{kind: SUPPLY\|WITHDRAW\|NONE, amount, at, explanation, txHash?}}` | snapshot + `liquidity_position` (ENG-013, the same formula as the liquidity cycle); `holds` = debt-service reserve + execution holds (0 until borrowing exists); `lastAction` is the latest completed liquidity plan step |
| `queues` | `{approvals, governance, review, reconciliation}` for this treasury and the caller's roles | approvals: APR, OWN (`AwaitingApproval`); governance: any member (`Collecting` and `Ready` transactions); review: open items assigned to one of the caller's roles; reconciliation: FIN, OWN, ADM (`Pending` and `Discrepancy`). A count the caller may not see is `0`. |
| `activity` | `[{id, at, actor: agent\|user\|chain, text, href?}]`, newest first, at most 10 | request status changes (`user` / `agent`) and observed inflows and unexpected outflows (`chain`) |

`mandate`, `queues` and `activity` are always present. `staleness`, `budgets`, `position` and the wallet figures are **left out, never zero**, until the worker has stored a first snapshot for the treasury (a Draft or ModulePending treasury, or a fresh deployment): a number is never returned without its `staleness`. `borrowProposalId` (a UUID, top level) is present only while the treasury has an open borrow proposal: when a liquidity cycle ends in `INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY` the worker stores the engine's `propose_borrow` estimate in `borrow_proposals` (base-unit amounts, status `Proposed`); a different shortfall supersedes it, and a cycle with no shortfall supersedes it too. The proposal is advisory and never a transaction (BR-044).

`mandate` supplies `validFrom`, `expiresAt`, `payeeCoolingSeconds`, `executor`, optional `guardian`, `pay`, `refill`, and `supply` limits (`perRequest` and `daily` as integer base-unit strings), `approvalMaxAge`, and `approvers`. `buffers` must contain exactly one `{wallet, minimum, target}` entry for T and every operational Safe. The endpoint returns separate Safe transactions because each Safe must authorize its own `enableModule` call.
| POST | `/orgs/{orgId}/treasuries/{tId}/coverage/refresh` | Re-read Safe configs | OWN, ADM | → `{coverage, details}` | 503 `RPC_UNAVAILABLE` |
| POST | `/orgs/{orgId}/treasuries/{tId}/coverage/acknowledge` | Accept PARTIAL coverage | OWN | `{reason}` → `{coverage}` | 409 `COVERAGE_COMPLETE` |

| Method | Endpoint | Purpose | Perm | Request → Response | Errors |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/orgs/{o}/treasuries/{t}/plans` | Recent plans | ANY | → `{items}` | |
| GET | `/orgs/{o}/plans/{pId}` | Plan, steps, validations, AI explanation, attestation | ANY | → `PlanDetail` | |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/treasuries/{t}/run-now` 🔁 | Operator trigger (same checks as the scheduler) | OPR, OWN | → `202 {jobId}` | 400 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`; 404 `TREASURY_NOT_FOUND`; 409 `TREASURY_PAUSED`, `TREASURY_NOT_READY`, `MANDATE_NOT_ACTIVE`, `COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE`, `UNKNOWN_OPERATION_PENDING`, `EXECUTING_PLAN_EXISTS` |
| GET | `/orgs/{o}/operations/{opId}` | Operation, transactions, verification | ANY | → `OperationDetail` | |
| GET | `/orgs/{o}/treasuries/{t}/forecast` | 7-day runway | ANY | `?includeDrafts=` → `{days[], wallets[], suggestedRefills[], alerts[]}` (see below) | 404 `TREASURY_NOT_FOUND`; 409 `MANDATE_NOT_ACTIVE`, `TREASURY_NOT_READY`; 503 `FORECAST_UNAVAILABLE` |
| GET | `/orgs/{o}/review-items` | Review queue | ANY (role-filtered) | `?status=Open&type=` → `{items}` | |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/review-items/{id}/actions` 🔁 | Retry, cancel, mark resolved, or edit and re-approve | role per type | `{action, note}` → `{item}` | 409 `STALE_ITEM`, 403 |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/plans/{pId}/fee/accept` | Accept a held plan at its system estimate; stores that estimate as the cap | OWN, FIN, OPR | `{reason?}` → `{planId, acceptedCapWei}` | 404 `FEE_REVIEW_NOT_FOUND`, 409 `FEE_REVIEW_STALE` |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/plans/{pId}/fee/defer` | Leave a held plan waiting for a cheaper window | OWN, FIN, OPR | `{reason?}` → `{planId, status: Deferred}` | 404 `FEE_REVIEW_NOT_FOUND`, 409 `FEE_REVIEW_STALE` |
| GET | `/orgs/{o}/events` | SSE stream: plan, operation, notification and request events | ANY | `text/event-stream` | |

**Forecast response.** Display-oriented; all amounts are base-unit strings, dates are ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`.

- `days[]`: the payments wallet (O1) series, `{date, balance, outflow, buffer}`.
- `wallets[]`: one series per operational wallet, `{role, label, safeAddress, buffer, days[{date, balance}]}`.
- `suggestedRefills[]`: `{date, sourceAddress, targetAddress, amount, requestId}`. `requestId` is required, as in the engine's `ForecastRefill`.
- `alerts[]`: `{date, message}`.

The API serializer maps the engine's `ForecastDay.day` index to an ISO date and wallet ids to Safe addresses. `buffer` comes from the mandate.

Inputs and failures. Balances are read from chain and today's PAY and REFILL usage from the module's `usedToday`, so the daily caps limit what lands today. `MANDATE_NOT_ACTIVE` also covers a mandate that does not validate, has no PAY or REFILL limits (no fallback), or has no buffer for an operational wallet. `TREASURY_NOT_READY` means a missing source or payments wallet, module or asset. A failed chain read is `FORECAST_UNAVAILABLE`.

Requests included: Approved, Scheduled and AwaitingApproval (plus Draft with `includeDrafts`), ordered by first valid approval time then id. Skipped: no amount, payee or confirmed terms, or a paying wallet outside the treasury's operational wallets. A request with no paying wallet is projected on O1 (the worker's planner requires one; the forecast is advisory and covers requests not yet assigned).

## 7. AI: Copilot (M09)

| GET | `/admin/tenants/{tenantId}/health` | Tenant status and basic health counts | staff bearer + source IP allowlist | Metadata only |

## 9. Error codes (stable)

These map 1:1 to validator reason codes where applicable, so the UI and the contract revert reasons line up.

| Code | Meaning | BR |
|---|---|---|
| `NOT_APPROVED`, `APPROVAL_INVALID`, `APPROVAL_EXPIRED`, `NOT_IN_APPROVER_SET` | Approval issues | BR-001, BR-003, BR-004 |
| `MAKER_CHECKER` | Creator or editor approving | BR-005 |
| `PAYEE_UNKNOWN`, `PAYEE_COOLING`, `SCREENING_HIT` | Payee issues | BR-013, BR-017, BR-085 |
| `OVER_PER_REQUEST_LIMIT` (→ NEEDS_APPROVAL), `OVER_DAILY_LIMIT` | Limits | BR-022, BR-040 |
| `BUFFER_BREACH`, `SOURCE_INSUFFICIENT` | Liquidity | BR-030, BR-033 |
| `DUPLICATE_FINGERPRINT`, `REQUEST_ALREADY_PAID`, `STEP_ALREADY_EXECUTED` | Replay | BR-061, BR-071 |
| `MANDATE_PAUSED`, `MANDATE_EXPIRED`, `MANDATE_NOT_ACTIVE` | Lifecycle | BR-015, BR-062 |
| `COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE`, `SNAPSHOT_STALE`, `UNKNOWN_OPERATION_PENDING` | Safety gates | BR-018, BR-051, BR-060 |
| `AI_PLAN_REJECTED`, `AI_UNAVAILABLE` | AI path | BR-055, BR-056 |
| `ATTESTATION_INVALID`, `PAYLOAD_MISMATCH` | Signer | BR-059 |
| `ATTESTATION_EXPIRED`, `NONCE_REUSED` | Signer | BR-059 |
| `FLAG_UNACKNOWLEDGED`, `APPROVAL_STALE`, `EXCEPTION_INVALID`, `NOT_OPERATIONAL_WALLET`, `WRONG_REFILL_TARGET`, `REFILL_PATH_NOT_ALLOWED`, `ALREADY_REFILLED_FOR_REQUEST`, `OVER_REFILL_PER_REQUEST`, `OVER_REFILL_DAILY`, `SOURCE_BUFFER_BREACH`, `REFILL_EXCEEDS_NEED`, `REFILL_BOUND`, `PAUSE_REQUESTED`, `CIRCUIT_OPEN`, `DATA_MISSING`, `CHAIN_MISMATCH`, `ASSET_MISMATCH`, `EXECUTOR_MISMATCH`, `MANDATE_REVOKED`, `PLAN_MALFORMED`, `SIMULATION_REVERTED`, `SIMULATION_UNAVAILABLE`, `OVER_SUPPLY_PER_TX`, `OVER_SUPPLY_DAILY`, `SUPPLY_FLOOR_BREACH`, `RESERVE_BREACH`, `INSUFFICIENT_POOL_LIQUIDITY`, `INSUFFICIENT_A_TOKEN`, `BORROW_NOT_AUTHORIZED`, `HEALTH_FACTOR_TOO_LOW`, `WRONG_PAYMENT_OPTION`, `TRANSFER_FAILED`, `BALANCE_DELTA_MISMATCH`, `ALLOWANCE_NOT_CLEARED`, `REQUEST_CANCELLED` | Added in M08; full catalogue with decisions and contract errors in docs/modules/policy-engine §6.4 | |
| Warnings: `DEADLINE_MISSED`, `DISCOUNT_MISSED`, `TARGET_NOT_REACHED`, `BELOW_MIN_SUPPLY` | Never change the decision | M08-D7 |
